+        text_chunks = re.findall(self.compiled_pattern, text)
+        # all chunks of text are encoded separately, then results are joined.
+        # chunks repeat a lot in natural text (" the", ","): encode each distinct
+        # chunk once per call, in first-seen order
+        cache = dict.fromkeys(text_chunks)
+        if type(self)._encode_chunk is RegexTokenizer._encode_chunk:
+            # not overridden: call apply_merges directly, with an int "no merge"
+            # sentinel above every merge index (int-int rank comparisons are
+            # much cheaper than int-float ones)
+            merges = self.merges
+            inf = max(merges.values(), default=0) + 1
+            for chunk in cache:
+                cache[chunk] = apply_merges(list(chunk.encode("utf-8")), merges, inf)
+        else:
+            encode_chunk = self._encode_chunk
+            for chunk in cache:
+                cache[chunk] = encode_chunk(chunk.encode("utf-8"))
+        # join the per-chunk ids in text order (in C)
+        return list(chain.from_iterable(map(cache.__getitem__, text_chunks)))
